note: Illinois DNR conservation area near Gladstone with a 27-acre fishing lake. Primitive tent and trailer sites with tables and grills along the shore wherever the park road reaches the lake; the main camping area is at the end of the paved road at the lake's west end. Site length not published. --Claude
